df = global_df.copy()

# Ensure required columns exist
required_cols = {"reference_outputs", "outputs"}
missing = required_cols - set(df.columns)
if missing:
    raise KeyError(f"Missing columns: {missing}")

import json

# Extract labels from JSON
def extract_expected(value):
    try:
        return json.loads(value).get("expected_route")
    except Exception:
        return None


def extract_predicted(value):
    try:
        return json.loads(value).get("route")
    except Exception:
        return None


df["ground_truth"] = df["reference_outputs"].apply(extract_expected)
df["prediction"] = df["outputs"].apply(extract_predicted)

# Remove rows with invalid labels
df = df.dropna(subset=["ground_truth", "prediction"])

y_true = df["ground_truth"]
y_pred = df["prediction"]

# Accuracy
accuracy = (y_true == y_pred).mean()

# Labels
labels = sorted(set(y_true) | set(y_pred))

precision_scores = []
recall_scores = []

# Compute TP, FP, FN for each class
for label in labels:
    tp = ((y_true == label) & (y_pred == label)).sum()
    fp = ((y_true != label) & (y_pred == label)).sum()
    fn = ((y_true == label) & (y_pred != label)).sum()

    precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
    recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0

    precision_scores.append(precision)
    recall_scores.append(recall)

# Macro metrics
macro_precision = np.mean(precision_scores)
macro_recall = np.mean(recall_scores)

# Macro F1
if macro_precision + macro_recall > 0:
    macro_f1 = (
        2 * macro_precision * macro_recall
        / (macro_precision + macro_recall)
    )
else:
    macro_f1 = 0

print(f"Accuracy : {accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {macro_precision:.4f}")
print(f"Recall   : {macro_recall:.4f}")
print(f"F1 Score : {macro_f1:.4f}")

# Confusion Matrix
conf_matrix = pd.crosstab(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    rownames=["Actual"],
    colnames=["Predicted"],
    dropna=False,
)

# Ensure every label appears as both row and column
conf_matrix = conf_matrix.reindex(
    index=labels,
    columns=labels,
    fill_value=0,
)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))

sns.heatmap(
    conf_matrix,
    annot=True,
    fmt="d",
    cmap="Blues",
)

plt.title("Confusion Matrix")
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    "/tmp/confusion_matrix.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight",
)

plt.close()

# Metrics bar chart
metrics = ["Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1 Score"]
values = [
    accuracy,
    macro_precision,
    macro_recall,
    macro_f1,
]

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))

bars = plt.bar(metrics, values)

plt.ylim(0, 1)
plt.ylabel("Score")
plt.title("Classification Metrics")

for bar, value in zip(bars, values):

    )

plt.tight_layout()

)

plt.close()
